## What changed

- The CI action's "Pages this pull request made due" section now shows in a
  private repository that checks out with `persist-credentials: false`. In
  v0.17.0 the script fetched the base branch first. That fetch fails without
  credentials, and the script then skipped the section. It now uses the
  `origin/BASE` that a `fetch-depth: 0` checkout already has, and fetches
  only when it is missing (#74).

## Before you upgrade

Nothing to do.

## Other changes

None.

## Install

```sh
uv tool install git+https://github.com/JasperHG90/kmctl@v0.17.1#subdirectory=packages/kmctl
```

In a workflow:

```yaml
- uses: JasperHG90/kmctl@v0.17.1
```
